description: **Venue change = Defuse Cafe** Open Coffee Lisbon is a friendly informal networking event for entrepreneurs, professionals, locals, guests, people in the startup community, and students in Lisbon.⁣ Your host for our event will be [Richard Lucas ](www.linkedin.com/in/richardhlucas/)with support from the Open Coffee Lisbon team. We are focused on business and social entrepreneurs, the startup community and anyone else who is doing something interesting or wants to get involved in other people's projects. You can talk about any project/topic. Open Coffee Lisbon is an “un-meeting” without a speaker or agenda. We are focused on attendees gaining value from other attendees. The rules, tools, structure and moderation aim to facilitate this goal. ⁣⁣What is the BIG idea behind Open Coffee? description: Hello hello! 👋 So, after receiving so much love from you all this month (and since I promised some of you I'd share my approach to preparing for investing), I'm organizing this little workshop to give back to the community. Our goal is simple: connect, exchange perspectives, and enjoy thoughtful conversation with fellow investors — whatever your experience level.

description: **The Lisbon GenAI Community is back for our 15th meetup** \- and this time we're teaming up with **Google Developer Group (GDG) Lisbon for the very first time**. **Two communities, one evening**, and three speakers diving into automation agents, on-device multimodal AI, and AI-powered code review. **🗓️ July 2nd\, 2026 \| 18:30 \| PagerDuty\, Alcântara\, Lisbon** A big thank you to PagerDuty for hosting us, and to our sponsors Google and synvert xgeeks for making this evening possible. *** **📅 Agenda** **18:30** — Check-in & Networking **19:00** — Opening & Community Intro Lisbon GenAI Community, GDG Lisbon & Partners **19:15 —** 🎤 *Talk 1: How Automation Agents are Transforming the Web* [Daniel Olavio](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-olavio/) — Head of Engineering @ UBIO In this talk, we'll explore the problem space around web automation and introduce A3, an AI agent that's reshaping how we build automations. Just as Cursor brought AI-assisted coding to developers, A3 brings that same paradigm to automation workflows — seeing websites, interacting with them, and learning from those interactions to produce durable, reusable scripts. We'll walk through how A3 works and see it in action with two real use cases: automating job board applications and building a UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) for hotel booking. **19:45 —** 🎤 *Talk 2: Massive OCR at the Edge: Building Privacy-First Document Pipelines with Gemma 4 & ADK* [Nuno Andrade](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nuno-andrade-964b2416/) — Google / Azure / AWS Cloud Platform Expert We will explore how to build robust, privacy-first document pipelines using the natively multimodal Gemma 4 family and the Agent Development Kit (ADK). By leveraging Gemma 4's highly optimized architecture — including the sub-1GB memory footprint of the E2B model — developers can process high-resolution documents, interpret complex charts, and extract structured data entirely offline. **20:15 —** 🎤 *Talk 3: Practical Workflows for AI Code Review* [David Pereira](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jose-david-pereira/) — Software Architect @ CloudCockpit AI adoption is on the rise throughout our SDLC, and so is the number of merged PRs. Speed over quality is not always a good trade-off, so code reviews remain essential. David will dive deep into adopting AI for code review using GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, sharing his team's pragmatic approach to measuring quality (signal-to-noise ratio and other metrics), plus the prompts and workflows that have worked — and the challenges along the way. **20:45 —** 🍕 Pizza, Drinks & Networking *** Entrance is free but the spots are limited — grab your ticket We can't wait to see you there! 👋 **Partners:** synvert xgeeks · PagerDuty · Google · GDG Lisbon
